title: Accept Jev's label on a raw entry
description: Raw triage files a label on a raw idea or reference when Jev's probability is at or above the line, or at or below one minus it. A label between the two is held for the founder (docs/design/RAW_TRIAGE_2026-11-09.md).

question.text: Is Jev's label on this raw entry right?

evidence.sensor: Jev (TypeSafe System 1), the client the platform injects

scale.meaning: Jev's probability for the label, 0 to 1

note: A held label the founder answers as Jev guessed is a false alarm; a filed label the founder changes is a miss.
